## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. AI Services & Production Architectures
- **Multi-Agent Systems**: Orchestrates LangGraph state machines, coordinating specialized agents with isolated task boundaries.
- **RAG & Vector Search**: Hybrid dense/sparse vector search, semantic chunking, and verifiable source citations.
- **Resilience & Failover**: Automatic fallback across OpenAI, Anthropic, and AWS Bedrock with exponential backoff and jitter.
- **Guardrails & Cost Controls**: Deterministic validation gates, token budget rate-limiting, and LangSmith/OpenTelemetry tracing.

### 2. Autonomous AI Workflows
- **Deterministic State Machines**: Moving fragile prompt loops into stateful, audit-trailed workflow engines.
- **Asynchronous Queuing**: RabbitMQ, Celery, and AWS SQS dead-letter queues preventing cascading agent failures.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Review**: Granular approval checkpoints for critical actions, financial disbursements, and external outputs.

### 3. SaaS Applications & Cloud Engineering
- **Multi-Tenant Architecture**: Concurrency-safe systems with Redis Redlock distributed mutexes.
- **Financial Ledgers**: Stripe Connect automated payouts, dispute handling, and transaction reconciliation.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Python (FastAPI), Node.js, PostgreSQL relational scaling, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (ECS, SQS, Bedrock, S3).

### 4. High-Performance Web Development
- **Modern Frameworks**: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components), React 19, TypeScript.
- **Edge Deployment**: Global delivery via Cloudflare Edge Network.
- **Interactive Experiences**: Bespoke dark UI, dynamic telemetry monitors, and Three.js / React Three Fiber visualizers.

## Representative Case Studies

- **Production RAG (Measurable Retrieval Architecture Reference)**: Public reference implementation showing how to structure production-oriented RAG with hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense embeddings), explicit reranking, grounded citations, Recall@5 and MRR evaluation, CI quality gates, and trace observability.
  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/production-rag/
- **Wellows (LLM Search Visibility Platform)**: Designed multi-agent architecture (KIVA, OPTA, Citation Intelligence) using LangGraph and a shared Qdrant retrieval layer. The platform measures brand citations in AI answers across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI, then closes gaps through automated content remediation at 10K+ articles/month.
  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/wellows/
- **ClassFlow (Live Tutoring Marketplace SaaS)**: Architected automated tutor matching across global timezones (<100ms), Redis Redlock concurrency locks to eliminate double-booking, and automated Stripe Connect teacher payouts.
  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/classflow/
- **Savyour (High-Throughput Fintech Ledger)**: Engineered cashback ledger balancing, affiliate attribution pipelines, and Redis caching for high-concurrency commercial transactions.
  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/savyour/
- **EFU Life (Enterprise Document Workflow Architecture)**: Modernized document-heavy insurance operations with IBM FileNet P8, IBM Capture, and Case Manager, converting physical records into automated digital approval queues.
  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/efu-life/
